(c) The stores shall be considered accepted only after satisfactory inspection and confirmation by the auth orized receiving authority. 6. Rejection of Stores The buyer reserves the right to reject the entire consignment or any individual item, as applicable, under t he following circumstances: (a) Items not conforming to the BOQ specifications or declared technical parameters. (d) Items supplied with incorrect specifications, model, capacity, dimensions or accessories. (e) Rechargeable batteries having leakage, swelling, physical damage or failure to meet the specified voltage and capacity. (f) Laser Pointers or Flash Light Guns found non-functional or not performing their intended function. (g) Acrylic Triangles/Arrows having improper dimensions, sharp edges, cracks, poor finishing or incorrect c olour. (h) Any item found unsuitable for the intended training purpose. 7. ACRYLIC TRIANGLES / ARROWS FOR CREATION OF LAND MARKS FOR SAND MODELS

Technical Specifications: - Material: Good quality transparent/coloured acrylic sheet. - Colours: Red, Blue, Green and Yellow, as specified in BOQ. - Properly finished edges without cracks, sharp edges or manufacturing defects. - Uniform shape, colour and thickness. - Suitable for repeated use during military training and sand model demonstrations. Documents Required: 1. Product catalogue or product photographs. 2. Technical specification sheet mentioning material, dimensions and thickness. 3. Colour-wise details of the offered product. 4. Manufacturer/supplier declaration confirming compliance with BOQ. Rejection Criteria: - Material other than acrylic. - Incorrect colours or shapes. - Cracked, bent, damaged or poorly finished items. - Dimensions or thickness not matching the declared specifications. - Items unsuitable for repeated training use. 2. M-SEAL Technical Specifications: - Two-component epoxy-based sealing/repair putty. - Proper mixing and setting properties. - Supplied in original, sealed and unused packaging. - Product shall have adequate remaining shelf life at the time of delivery. - Suitable for general repair and sealing applications. Documents Required: 1. Product datasheet. 2. Manufacturer's product specification. 3. Product photograph showing original packaging. 4. Shelf-life details and batch information. Rejection Criteria: - Expired or near-expiry material. - Opened, damaged or tampered packaging. - Single-component product instead of two-component epoxy putty. - Material having hardened, deteriorated or unusable contents. - Product not matching the declared specifications. 3. LASER POINTER Technical Specifications: - Brand-new laser pointer with proper functional mechanism. - Clearly specified laser output, wavelength and operating range. - Suitable for training demonstrations and instructional purposes. - Proper switch mechanism and durable body. - Safe operating design; laser class and output shall comply with applicable safety standards. Documents Required: 1. Manufacturer's technical datasheet. 2. Product catalogue with make and model. 3. Laser output and wavelength specifications. 4. Applicable safety/compliance certificate, wherever required.

5. Warranty certificate of minimum 12 months, if stipulated in the bid. Rejection Criteria: - Laser pointer found non-functional. - Technical parameters not matching the offered specifications. - Missing or unverifiable manufacturer/model details. - Unsafe laser output or non-compliance with applicable safety requirements. - Damaged body, defective switch or inconsistent operation. 4. RECHARGEABLE BATTERY – EN-EL15, 7.0V, 1900 mAh Technical Specifications: - Battery type: EN-EL15 compatible rechargeable lithium-ion battery. - Rated voltage: 7.0V. - Capacity: Minimum 1900 mAh. - Compatible with the specified EN-EL15 device and charging system. - Proper charging and discharging performance. - Built-in protection against overcharging, overheating and short circuit. - Brand-new, unused and supplied in original protective packaging. Documents Required: 1. Manufacturer's technical datasheet. 2. Make, model and battery specifications. 3. Voltage and capacity details. 4. Compatibility declaration for EN-EL15. 5. OEM/manufacturer warranty certificate. 6. Product photographs showing model and specifications. Rejection Criteria: - Battery voltage or capacity below the specified requirement. - Incorrect battery model or incompatible design. - Used, refurbished, old-stock or damaged battery. - Leakage, swelling or physical damage. - Battery failing charging or discharging tests. - Unverifiable specifications or false compatibility claims. 5.
